# Range slider

> A native range input for picking one number along a scale: a 44px hit area, a 16px track with an accent fill, a 20px thumb.

Part of the [Nate Mills Design System](../README.md). It is a CSS class API, not a JavaScript component, so its props are the classes and HTML attributes below. Link the stylesheets as [Getting started](../foundations/getting-started.md) shows, then add the classes. Every component: [Components](../COMPONENTS.md).

## When to use

- Picking one number from a known range, where an exact value matters less than the feel, such as an icon size or a simulated width.
- A value the page shows live as it changes, with the number written next to the slider.

## When not to use

- An exact number the reader must type or read back with care: use a text field, which this system does not have yet.
- A choice between a few named options: use Tabs, or a group of Buttons.
- Running an action once: use a Button.

## Alternatives

- **[Button](button.md):** A range slider picks one value along a scale and keeps it. A Button runs an action once.

## How to use

**Element:** `<input type="range">` with a `<label>`.

- Put `.uw-range` on an `<input type="range">` with `min`, `max`, `step` and `value`, and a `<label for>` that names it.
- For the accent fill, set `--range-pct` on the input as a percentage, now and on every change: `(value - min) / (max - min)`. natemills.me does this with a small script; without it the track shows no fill and the slider still works.
- Show the current value in words or numbers beside the label, and point the input at it with `aria-describedby` when it is not in the label.

**Classes:** `.uw-range`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `min, max, step` | attributes on the input | Numbers | 0, 100, 1 | The scale and its smallest move. |
| `value` | attribute on the input | A number from min to max | The middle of the scale | The starting position. |
| `--range-pct` | custom property on the input | A percentage, such as 40% | 0% | How much of the track the accent fills, left of the thumb. The page sets it. |
| `aria-describedby` | attribute on the input, id reference | The `id` of the element that shows the value | None. | Optional: reads the live value after the label. |

## Variants

Available variants: none. `.uw-range` has one look and takes no modifiers.

## States

| State | What changes | Tokens |
|---|---|---|
| `default` | A pale track with a 2px dark edge, the accent fill left of the thumb, and a pale round thumb with the same edge. | `--color-surface`, `--color-dot-inactive`, `--color-accent` |
| `focus-visible` | The system ring on the input, and the thumb edge turns the focus colour. | `--border-focus`, `--color-focus-ring` |

The CSS styles these pseudo-classes: `:focus-visible`.

## Invalid combinations

Options that must not be used together. Each names the props above.

| Combination | Level | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `.uw-range` on an element that is not an `<input type="range">` | MUST NOT | The track and thumb are native parts of the range input; nothing else has them. |
| `.uw-range` on an input with no `<label>` | MUST NOT | A screen reader announces an unnamed slider. |
| `.uw-range` with a height set on top of it | SHOULD NOT | The 44px height is the touch target. |

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab | Moves focus onto the slider, then on to the next control. |
| Left arrow, Down arrow | Lower the value by one step. |
| Right arrow, Up arrow | Raise the value by one step. |
| Home, End | Jump to the lowest or highest value. |
| Page Up, Page Down | Raise or lower the value by a larger step. |

The browser supplies every key: the CSS only draws the slider.

## Rules

| Level | Rule | Checked by |
|---|---|---|
| MUST | Name every slider with a `<label>`. | [Manual: Range slider review](../foundations/checks.md#range-slider-review) |
| MUST | Keep the 44px hit area, so the target stays at 44px. | [Manual: Range slider review](../foundations/checks.md#range-slider-review) |
| MUST | Show a visible focus ring when the slider has keyboard focus. | [Manual: Range slider review](../foundations/checks.md#range-slider-review) |

Automated checks run on natemills.me before every publish; the scripts live in the private source repository.

## Example

```html
<label for="size">Size</label>
<input class="uw-range" type="range" id="size" min="20" max="56" step="2" value="30" style="--range-pct: 30%">
```

## Tokens

Every token the classes above read, as data from tokens.json: write `var(--name)`, never the raw value. A component token belongs to one component: change it to restyle that component and nothing else. A semantic token is a shared role; never change one for a single component. The three tiers: [Tokens](../foundations/tokens.md#three-tiers).

| Token | Tier | Value | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bar-radius` | Semantic | `999px`, from `--radius-full` | End-cap rounding for thin bars, rails, tracks, indicators, and capsule strips (progress rails, tab indicators, slider tracks, chart bars, the hero edge widget's pill). Full by definition; it rounds the ends of a strip at any height. |
| `--border-focus` | Semantic | `2px solid var(--color-focus-ring)` | 2px focus outline; reads --color-focus-ring (ink on light, lime on dark). The keyboard-focus indicator, never removed without a replacement. |
| `--color-accent` | Semantic | `#1c1c1f`; dark `#d2ff37`, from `--neutral-850` | The single theme-aware interactive role: ink on light, brand lime on dark. Active and selected states. |
| `--color-dot-inactive` | Semantic | `#67676f`; dark `#a1a1aa`, from `--neutral-600` | Was the unfilled half of the carousel position indicator. Solid theme-aware grey: clears the SC 1.4.11 3:1 floor on light surfaces; dark themes override to neutral-500. |
| `--color-focus-ring` | Semantic | `#1c1c1f`; dark `#d2ff37`, from `--neutral-850` | Theme-aware keyboard-focus colour: ink on light, lime on dark. Consumed via border.focus. |
| `--color-surface` | Semantic | `#ffffff`; dark `#1c1c1f`, from `--neutral-0` | The default card / panel surface. White card on the grey page in light (a genuine lift); the lighter near-black (#1c1c1f) in dark. |
| `--dot-radius` | Semantic | `999px`, from `--radius-full` | Circle geometry: dots, markers, slider thumbs, and drawn circles (the brand period, status dots, touch-target rings). Full by definition: a re-theme that softens buttons leaves a dot round, and the theme lab's corner tier squares it only when the whole system goes sharp (0 at sharp, full at soft and round). |
| `--focus-ring-offset` | Semantic | `2px` | Offset between an element and its focus ring. Outsets the 2px ring so it clears the element edge. |
| `--space-100` | Semantic | `4px` | Hairline gap. Icon-to-label, tight inline spacing. |
| `--space-400` | Semantic | `16px` | Base unit. Default gap between related elements; the compact card-padding tier (--card-pad-compact). |
| `--touch-target-min` | Semantic | `44px` | Minimum size of a tappable control such as a button or icon button (44px, WCAG 2.5.5). The AA floor for small carousel dots is touch-target-dot (24px). |
